TechStack.description: We work with the technologies that power the world's most demanding applications. No experiments on your dime—proven tools, proven results.
TechStack.statement: Our engineers stay current with evolving technologies while maintaining deep expertise in battle-tested solutions. We choose the right tool for each job.

fintech.title: Digital Mortgage & Fincheck
fintech.challenge: Traditional mortgage applications required multiple in-person visits and weeks of manual processing.
fintech.solution: Integrated BankID for instant KYC and developed 'Fincheck' for automated financial health assessments and online applications.
fintech.outcome: First-to-market digital mortgage flow in the region with instant eligibility feedback and reduced time-to-offer.

proptech.title: National Real Estate Ecosystem (MLS)
proptech.challenge: The real estate market lacked a unified source of data, leading to fragmentation and lack of transparency for brokers and buyers.
proptech.solution: Engineered the first comprehensive Multiple Listing Service (MLS) integrated with the national Land Registry (Katastr nemovitostí).
proptech.outcome: Created a single source of truth for 10,000+ brokers, enabling seamless cooperation and transaction transparency.

enterprise.title: AI-Powered Property Search
enterprise.challenge: Users struggled to find properties based on visual preference or location-specific data amidst thousands of listings.
enterprise.solution: Implemented AI-driven visual search for property styles and Augmented Reality (AR) for on-site property discovery.
enterprise.outcome: Increased user engagement by 3x through intuitive, 'point-and-see' property exploration and personalized search.

About.label: About Us
About.title: Engineering partners, not vendors
About.description1: We founded BLAiT to redefine the standard of external technical collaboration. We moved away from traditional outsourcing models to eliminate misaligned incentives, communication gaps, and the "talent lottery." We built something better.
About.description2: Our engineers work from European time zones with significant overlap with both EU and US business hours. We operate under strict EU legal frameworks (GDPR) and bring cultural alignment that goes beyond language—we don't just take tickets; we challenge requirements to build better products.

excellence.title: Engineering Excellence
excellence.desc: We hire elite seniors and autonomous mid-level engineers. No juniors, no trainees. We invest in top-tier delivery from Day 1.

transparent.title: Transparent Partnership
transparent.desc: No black boxes. Full visibility into progress, challenges, and decisions.

impact.title: Business Impact Focus
impact.desc: Code is a means, not an end. We measure success by business outcomes.

longterm.title: Long-term Thinking
longterm.desc: We build systems meant to last and evolve. No quick wins that create tech debt.

discovery.title: Discovery & Architecture
discovery.description: We analyze your technical landscape and business goals to define the system boundaries before a single line of code is written.

matching.title: Architectural Alignment
matching.description: We don’t just 'fill seats'. We assemble a senior crew with the exact domain experience to execute the defined architecture.

integration.title: Code Quality & Peer Review
integration.description: Every line of code is peer-reviewed. We enforce Clean Code standards and CI/CD best practices to ensure zero-debt delivery.

delivery.title: Production & Evolution
delivery.description: We ship to production with confidence. We sell longevity, not just hours—building systems designed to last.

models.title: Engagement Models
models.subtitle: Flexible arrangements to fit your needs

augmentation.title: Product Engineering Partner
augmentation.desc: Individual engineers embedded in your team, working your hours, using your tools.

team.title: Dedicated Team
team.desc: A full squad with complementary skills, managed as a cohesive unit.

project.title: Project-Based
project.desc: We provide end-to-end project execution within a defined scope and timeline. Depending on your requirements, we offer both Fixed-Price or Hourly rates billing models to ensure full alignment with your budgetary needs.

start.question: How quickly can you start?
start.answer: We typically start within 48 hours of our initial consultation. Our process is streamlined to get us integrated with your team as fast as possible.

timezone.question: Do you work in my time zone?
timezone.answer: Yes, we are based in the EU but work across US and European time zones. We ensure at least 4 hours of overlap with your core working hours.

pricing.question: What is your pricing model?
pricing.answer: We offer Cost-Efficient Delivery models including product engineering partnerships and project-based fixed pricing. We focus on Optimized ROI by delivering high-quality code that reduces long-term maintenance costs.

pm.question: How do you handle legacy code modernization?
pm.answer: We take a pragmatic approach to legacy debt. Our team can either incrementally refactor your existing monolith into microservices or build new high-performance features that integrate seamlessly with your current stack.

security.question: Is your engineering compliant with FinTech standards?
security.answer: Yes. We incorporate secure SDLC, OWASP best practices, and automated security scanning from day one. Our team is experienced in building systems for regulated environments like GDPR, PSD2, and ISO 27001.

hero.label: Security & Compliance
hero.title: Security by Design
hero.subtitle: We don’t bolt security on at the end. It’s baked into every commit, every container, and every cloud resource we touch.

compliance.title: Compliance & Standards
compliance.description: Our internal processes are designed to align with the frameworks that matter to you. While we are an engineering partner, not a hosting provider, we operate with the rigor of a regulated entity.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliant
gdpr.text: All our engineers and operations are based in the EU/EEA or equivalent jurisdictions. Data Protection Agreements (DPA) are standard in every engagement.

iso.title: ISO 27001 Aligned
iso.text: We follow information security management best practices, including documented access controls, incident response plans, and asset management.

soc2.title: SOC2 Readiness
soc2.text: For US clients, we align with SOC2 Trust Services Criteria. We implement change management, logical access, and monitoring controls by default.

aws.title: Cloud Security
aws.text: We use AWS/GCP best practices: Well-Architected Framework, least-privilege IAM roles, and separate VPCs for environments.

encryption.title: Encryption Everywhere
encryption.text: Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). We manage secrets using enterprise-grade vaults (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

access.title: Zero Trust Access
access.text: No VPNs, no shared passwords. We access infrastructure via short-lived credentials and identity-aware proxies.

review.title: Mandatory Peer Review
review.text: No code reaches production without at least one senior engineer approval. We check for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities during review.

scanning.title: Automated Scanning
scanning.text: CI/CD pipelines include SAST (Static Analysis), DAST (Dynamic Analysis), and specialized dependency scanning to catch vulnerabilities early.

supply.title: Supply Chain Security
supply.text: We pin dependency versions, use signed commits, and regularly audit third-party libraries for CVEs.

cta.title: Have specific compliance needs?
cta.text: We are happy to discuss our security protocols and align with your vendor assessment requirements.
